dossier.claim: A plausible-looking English word sometimes selects the wrong sense of the Japanese expression. The resulting sentence can be fluent while giving the reader a different object, property, or action.
dossier.sourcePattern: The relevant sense is constrained by the scene: an obstructed way ahead, certainty that demons exist, a detached account of one’s own identity, disrupted footing, flawless Projection, and aimless running.
dossier.englishEffect: 行く手 becomes “hands,” 確固として becomes tenacity rather than definite existence, and 他人事 becomes “objectively.” Elsewhere, staggering becomes planting one’s feet, an imperceptible flaw becomes a wasted minute, and a discourse prompt becomes “the nice thing.”
dossier.limits: A dictionary alternative is not an error unless the surrounding construction or event rules it out. Synonymous names for the justice ideal, figurative descriptions, and uncommon but intelligible English are excluded when the alleged changed sense cannot be established. The translation also selects contextual senses correctly, as the counterexamples show.
dossier.diagnostic: 871 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

findings.explanation: The Counter Force is translated as the world's restraining power.

contexts.japanese: それこそ抑止力が発動する
contexts.english: The world's restraining power will be activated

findings.description: Rin's reserve of physical grit becomes latent energy after her mana is exhausted.
findings.sourceReading: 底力 is last-ditch inner strength that surprises even her as she runs soaking wet.
findings.explanation: Rin's reserve of physical grit becomes latent energy after her mana is exhausted.

contexts.japanese: 自分でも呆れるぐらいの底力で
contexts.english: with latent energy that shocks even her.

findings.description: The female swordswoman is called a swordsman.
findings.sourceReading: 剣士 neutrally identifies Saber as the sword fighter accepting her battle's end.
findings.explanation: The female swordswoman is called a swordsman.

contexts.japanese: 剣士は戦いの終わりを受け入れた
contexts.english: the swordsman accepted the end of her battle.

findings.description: Permission to remain and watch becomes mere possibility.
findings.sourceReading: 許されるのなら frames Saber's wish in terms of whether staying is permitted/justified after her role ends.
findings.explanation: Permission to remain and watch becomes mere possibility.

contexts.japanese: 許されるのなら—彼らの行く末を、最期まで見守りたかった
contexts.english: If possible... she wanted to watch over what awaits them until the end.

findings.description: The temple pond is again called a lake.
findings.sourceReading: The flash comes from the pond behind Shirou.
findings.explanation: The temple pond is again called a lake.

contexts.japanese: 池の方から走り抜けた閃光
contexts.english: The flash of light coming from the lake

findings.description: A black aperture is initially labeled an astrophysical black hole.
findings.sourceReading: 孔 is the round opening that appears in Gilgamesh's body; subsequent English itself switches to void.
findings.explanation: A black aperture is initially labeled an astrophysical black hole.

contexts.japanese: 黒い孔
contexts.english: A black hole.

findings.description: Stopping his resistance becomes casually loosening up.
findings.sourceReading: 力を抜く asks whether he should cease exerting force and let the chain pull him so Gilgamesh falls too.
findings.explanation: Stopping his resistance becomes casually loosening up.

contexts.japanese: 力を抜くべきか
contexts.english: should I loosen up?

findings.description: Rin's uncompromising softness becomes indulgence.
findings.sourceReading: 甘くなくては張り合いがない says her realism must coexist with thorough softheartedness/sweetness for her to be herself to Archer.
findings.explanation: Rin's uncompromising softness becomes indulgence.

contexts.japanese: とことん甘くなくては張り合いがない
contexts.english: and indulgent.

findings.description: Speaking as if it concerned someone else becomes speaking objectively.
findings.sourceReading: 他人事のように marks Archer's distancing: he talks about his own other self as though it were another person's affair.
findings.explanation: Speaking as if it concerned someone else becomes speaking objectively.

contexts.japanese: 他人事のように、騎士は言った
contexts.english: The knight says objectively.

findings.description: A rushing sound becomes a breeze.
findings.sourceReading: ざあ names the audible rush at the instant Archer disappears.
findings.explanation: A rushing sound becomes a breeze.

contexts.japanese: ざあ、という音
contexts.english: A breeze.

findings.description: Rin's pained look is specified as sorrow.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks that, for an instant, Rin seemed to bow her head painfully or in distress while running; the kind of distress is not named.
findings.explanation: Rin's pained look is specified as sorrow.

contexts.japanese: 辛そうに俯いた気がした。
contexts.english: I thought Tohsaka had hung her head in sorrow

findings.description: The attacks' lack of mercy becomes lack of hesitation.
findings.sourceReading: The exchange has neither pause nor mercy; every blow carries lethal intent.
findings.explanation: The attacks' lack of mercy becomes lack of hesitation.

contexts.japanese: そこに間断はなく、容赦はない。
contexts.english: Those attacks are continuous, without hesitation.

findings.description: Dogged, almost plodding training becomes training in a frank manner.
findings.sourceReading: Mind's Eye is reachable by anyone who piles up training with almost foolish single-minded persistence; it is an acquired ordinary person's weapon, unlike Saber's innate instinct.
findings.explanation: Dogged, almost plodding training becomes training in a frank manner.

contexts.japanese: 愚直なまでに修練を重ねれば誰にでも手が届く、凡人故の武器だった。
contexts.english: it is a simple weapon that anyone can gain from training in a frank manner.

findings.description: A Noble Phantasm powerful enough to stop the legendary spear becomes one that is not superficial.
findings.sourceReading: If the spear follows its legend, no half-measure or ordinary Noble Phantasm will suffice to block it.
findings.explanation: A Noble Phantasm powerful enough to stop the legendary spear becomes one that is not superficial.

contexts.japanese: 防ぐ宝具は生半可な物では済まされまい
contexts.english: the Noble Phantasm that blocks it cannot be superficial.

findings.description: The English repeats Shirou's inability to dodge instead of explaining that he cannot initiate a defense against fists he cannot see.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to see Kuzuki's fists, Shirou cannot initiate a defense himself; this follows a separate statement about his inability to evade narrowly.
findings.explanation: The English repeats Shirou's inability to dodge instead of explaining that he cannot initiate a defense against fists he cannot see.

contexts.japanese: 見えていないんだから、自分から防ぐ事など不可能だ。
contexts.english: I can't see them, so it's impossible to even dodge them.

findings.description: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.
findings.sourceReading: Caster praises Rin for completely defending against the spells, then explains that guarding only herself would preserve the jewels.
findings.explanation: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.

contexts.japanese: あら、綺麗に防ぎきるのね。
contexts.english: Oh, you dodge them well.

findings.description: A kick intended almost to break Caster's legs becomes kicking them off.
findings.sourceReading: Rin's full-body sweep explodes as if it might kick and break Caster's legs.
findings.explanation: A kick intended almost to break Caster's legs becomes kicking them off.

contexts.japanese: キャスターの足を蹴り折らんとばかりに炸裂する
contexts.english: as if trying to kick off Caster's legs.

findings.description: Shirou’s sense that his relief is improper becomes the generic “bad.”
findings.sourceReading: He is relieved despite recognizing that laughing in this grave situation is inappropriate or unseemly.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s sense that his relief is improper becomes the generic “bad.”

contexts.japanese: 不謹慎ながら、少しだけ安心できた。
contexts.english: It's bad, but that made me a bit relieved.

findings.description: A miracle achieved while bleeding becomes a miracle obtained with blood.
findings.sourceReading: The ordinary man achieves a miracle through effort while shedding blood.
findings.explanation: A miracle achieved while bleeding becomes a miracle obtained with blood.

contexts.japanese: 血を流しながら成し得た奇蹟
contexts.english: obtained a miracle with his own blood.

findings.description: A coldly ruthless cleanup man becomes a calm assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Archer has lost his former intimacy and now looks like a cold, merciless “cleaner,” echoing a Guardian’s role in clearing disasters.
findings.explanation: A coldly ruthless cleanup man becomes a calm assassin.

contexts.japanese: 今のあいつは本当に、冷徹な“掃除屋”だった。
contexts.english: He is really a calm assassin now.

findings.description: A convenient or self-serving ideal theory becomes feel-good idealism.
findings.sourceReading: Archer condemns Shirou's doctrine as 都合のいい: an ideal theory convenient to the person holding it because it ignores its structural cost.
findings.explanation: A convenient or self-serving ideal theory becomes feel-good idealism.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎という男が抱いていたものは、都合のいい理想論だった
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya was clinging to a mere feel-good idealism.

findings.description: Human desire becomes human despair.
findings.sourceReading: Archer's endpoint is an existence used only to erase the 欲望—desires or avarice—produced by humanity.
findings.explanation: Human desire becomes human despair.

contexts.japanese: 人間が生み出した欲望を消す為だけの存在。
contexts.english: an existence that erases the despair other humans make.

findings.description: English makes Archer's condemnation explicitly moral, where the Japanese calls the ideal untenable and explains it as a fairy tale.
findings.sourceReading: Archer calls the ideal broken or untenable, then describes its aspirations as a fairy tale.
findings.explanation: English makes Archer's condemnation explicitly moral, where the Japanese calls the ideal untenable and explains it as a fairy tale.

contexts.japanese: その理想は破綻している。
contexts.english: Your ideals are morally bankrupt.

findings.description: Air that is clammy and wet becomes lukewarm.
findings.sourceReading: The air is damp and clings to Shirou's skin like mucous membrane, building the sense of climbing a living organ.
findings.explanation: Air that is clammy and wet becomes lukewarm.

contexts.japanese: 空気はじっとりと湿り、粘膜のように肌にまとわりつく。
contexts.english: The air feels uncomfortably lukewarm, and it sticks to my skin.

findings.description: Saber's colorless voice becomes a voice lacking grace.
findings.sourceReading: Shock strips emotional color from her voice when she recognizes Assassin.
findings.explanation: Saber's colorless voice becomes a voice lacking grace.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの声に色はない。
contexts.english: Her voice lacks its usual grace.

findings.description: “Freely reels” makes Assassin's effortless handling of the long sword harder to understand. Saber still cannot approach him, so the passage retains his tactical control.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin handles the nearly two-meter weapon freely and expertly, preventing Saber from entering her effective range.
findings.explanation: “Freely reels” makes Assassin's effortless handling of the long sword harder to understand. Saber still cannot approach him, so the passage retains his tactical control.

contexts.japanese: 二メートル近い長物を自在に繰る
contexts.english: freely reels a nearly two-meter long sword

findings.description: Magic Circuits structurally collapsing become corroding.
findings.sourceReading: The circuits that move Rin's ample supply are failing from their foundations under the load.
findings.explanation: Magic Circuits structurally collapsing become corroding.

contexts.japanese: 回路自体が、根本から倒壊しかけている。
contexts.english: my circuits moving that energy are on the verge of corrosion.

findings.description: The long blade effortlessly mowing down a retreating torso becomes being able to make contact.
findings.sourceReading: Retreat offers no escape because the long sword will sweep through the fleeing torso without difficulty.
findings.explanation: The long blade effortlessly mowing down a retreating torso becomes being able to make contact.

contexts.japanese: 長刀は苦もなく逃げる胴を薙ぐだろう。
contexts.english: the long katana will be able to make contact if the target tries to retreat back.

findings.description: Saber pulling her embedded sword out of Assassin becomes drawing her sword.
findings.sourceReading: After Assassin tells her to go, Saber pulls the sword back out of his pierced body and runs up the steps.
findings.explanation: Saber pulling her embedded sword out of Assassin becomes drawing her sword.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは剣を引き抜き、全速で階段を駆け上がっていく。
contexts.english: Saber draws her sword and runs up the stairs with all her might.

findings.description: Creating nothing from within oneself becomes creating nothing by one's own accord.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh attacks Shirou for having produced nothing that originates in his own self.
findings.explanation: Creating nothing from within oneself becomes creating nothing by one's own accord.

contexts.japanese: 自身から生み出したモノが一つとしてない男
contexts.english: someone who has not created a single thing from his own accord

findings.description: Gilgamesh having heaps of weapons becomes having weapons 'at bay.'
findings.sourceReading: Shirou mocks the idea of holding Ea back when Gilgamesh possesses such a mountain of weapons.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh having heaps of weapons becomes having weapons 'at bay.'

contexts.japanese: そんだけ山ほど持っておいて
contexts.english: when you have mounds of weapons at bay?

findings.description: Shirou's body swaying before he braces his right arm becomes turning.
findings.sourceReading: He sways, then grips his extended right arm with his left while staring at Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: Shirou's body swaying before he braces his right arm becomes turning.

contexts.japanese: ゆらり、と。
contexts.english: I turn.

findings.description: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says that if he can reproduce Archer’s swords, that capability will constitute immediately deployable fighting strength.
findings.explanation: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.

contexts.japanese: 再現できれば即戦力じゃないっ！
contexts.english: you'll be useful right away if you just recreate that!

findings.description: Shirou’s irritation is rendered with the nonexistent idiom “gets my gall.”
findings.sourceReading: He knows he is half-trained, but hearing Rin say so still irritates him.
findings.explanation: Shirou says Rin’s remark irritates him. “Gets my gall” mixes English expressions for irritation without producing the intended idiom.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂にそう言われるとカチンとくる。
contexts.english: it gets my gall that Tohsaka says so.

findings.description: Fresh, succulent vegetables become ripe vegetables.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says she is not vegetarian but that fresh, juicy vegetables are indispensable to a meal.
findings.explanation: Fresh, succulent vegetables become ripe vegetables.

contexts.japanese: 瑞々しい野菜は食事に欠かせない
contexts.english: ripe vegetables are a must for every meal.

findings.description: Taiga says Shirou finally worked up the resolve to invite Rin, but English says he went through trouble.
findings.sourceReading: Her tease frames the invitation as a rare act of determined courage or initiative.
findings.explanation: Taiga says Shirou finally worked up the resolve to invite Rin, but English says he went through trouble.

contexts.japanese: せっかく一念発起して誘ったのに
contexts.english: After going through all that trouble to invite her

findings.description: The Emiya workshop is described with the malformed phrase “feels real naturalistic.”
findings.sourceReading: Rin says the house feels extremely natural or unforced for a magus’s workshop and is unusually open.
findings.explanation: Rin describes the house as unusually natural and open for a mage’s workshop. “Naturalistic” describes imitation of nature, changing the word’s sense in this household contrast.

contexts.japanese: この屋敷はすごく自然なのよ。
contexts.english: this house feels real naturalistic.

findings.description: Rin cooperating because Shirou is interesting becomes cooperating because he is funny.
findings.sourceReading: She finds him an interesting person or case, consistent with curiosity and engagement rather than saying he makes her laugh.
findings.explanation: Rin cooperating because Shirou is interesting becomes cooperating because he is funny.

contexts.japanese: 貴方が面白いからだし
contexts.english: I'm working with you because you're funny.

findings.description: Shirou’s cooperative alliance with Rin becomes a truce.
findings.sourceReading: He reasons that even though they are working together, Rin remains the school idol and a same-age girl whose entry into his house overwhelms him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s cooperative alliance with Rin becomes a truce.

contexts.japanese: いくら協力関係だって言っても
contexts.english: Even if we're in a truce

findings.description: Kiritsugu being absent-minded and unimpressive becomes being a klutz.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou fondly recalls Kiritsugu as habitually vague and somehow lacking in sharpness or distinction.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu being absent-minded and unimpressive becomes being a klutz.

contexts.japanese: 普段はぼーっとしていて、どうも冴えなかった。
contexts.english: He was often spacey and a klutz.

findings.description: The other participants’ designs or motives become their expectations.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever intentions bring someone into the war, participation requires displacing rivals to survive.
findings.explanation: The other participants’ designs or motives become their expectations.

contexts.japanese: どのような思惑だろうと
contexts.english: No matter what your expectations are

findings.description: Saber’s presence like pure water becomes like still water.
findings.sourceReading: Her silent, upright presence evokes clean or sacredly pure water, preparing Shirou’s thought that she is holy.
findings.explanation: Saber’s presence like pure water becomes like still water.

contexts.japanese: 清らかな水を思わせる。
contexts.english: like nothing so much as still water.

findings.description: Saber’s presence like pure water becomes like still water.
findings.sourceReading: Her silent, upright presence evokes clean or sacredly pure water, preparing Shirou’s thought that she is holy.
findings.explanation: Saber’s presence like pure water becomes like still water.

contexts.japanese: 清らかな水を思わせる。
contexts.english: like nothing so much as still water.

findings.description: Doubt that Shirou can enter 会心 becomes doubt that he can hit the target.
findings.sourceReading: Because his attitude is not prepared, Shirou doubts whether he can enter the concentrated or unified state he calls 会心.
findings.explanation: Doubt that Shirou can enter 会心 becomes doubt that he can hit the target.

contexts.japanese: これじゃ会心に入れるかも怪しい
contexts.english: I don't know if I'll even hit the target.

findings.description: 'Paragon' preserves Shirou's grand introduction but replaces Issei's iron firmness with general excellence.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou jokingly presents Issei as a man of iron devoted to smooth organizational functioning.
findings.explanation: 'Paragon' preserves Shirou's grand introduction but replaces Issei's iron firmness with general excellence.

contexts.japanese: 円滑な組織運動を目指している鉄の男だ
contexts.english: a paragon that strives for organizational harmony.

findings.description: Futons become beds.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga proposes the rear tatami room because the house has plenty of futons.
findings.explanation: Futons become beds.

contexts.japanese: 布団ならいっぱいある
contexts.english: We have plenty of beds

findings.description: Yukata become pajamas.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga says the household has enough yukata for everyone.
findings.explanation: Yukata become pajamas.

contexts.japanese: 浴衣も人数分ある
contexts.english: pajamas for all of us

findings.description: An unidentified building becomes “a random building,” in an unidiomatic construction that adds arbitrariness.
findings.sourceReading: The scene identifies only a room in a certain or unspecified building.
findings.explanation: An unidentified building becomes “a random building,” in an unidiomatic construction that adds arbitrariness.

contexts.japanese: ある建物の一室
contexts.english: a room of a random building

findings.description: Archer’s complaint that they exposed their hand becomes disclosure of the extent of their power.
findings.sourceReading: He says their concealed techniques or available cards were revealed to an observer.
findings.explanation: Archer’s complaint that they exposed their hand becomes disclosure of the extent of their power.

contexts.japanese: こちらは手の内を晒してしまった
contexts.english: we gave away the scope of our power.

findings.description: Archer’s idiom becomes the malformed “You can’t stand without starting a fight.”
findings.sourceReading: He observes that Rin will not be satisfied unless she picks a fight.
findings.explanation: Archer says Rin cannot be satisfied without picking a fight. “Can’t stand without starting a fight” loses what she cannot stand or what would satisfy her.

contexts.japanese: 喧嘩を売らなければ気が済まない
contexts.english: You can't stand without starting a fight

findings.description: Shirou’s tentative recollection of a named archery text is reduced to an unnamed manual.
findings.sourceReading: He thinks the saying was in something around or like the Chūyō Hikan-shū, preserving uncertainty about the exact source while still naming it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative recollection of a named archery text is reduced to an unnamed manual.

contexts.japanese: たしか中要秘刊集あたりにあった言葉だ
contexts.english: I think I read it somewhere in an archery manual.

findings.description: A person aspiring to become an archer is called a “shooter,” flattening the kyūdō register into an unnatural generic term.
findings.sourceReading: The maxim addresses one who resolves to become an archer or bowman.
findings.explanation: A person aspiring to become an archer is called a “shooter,” flattening the kyūdō register into an unnatural generic term.

contexts.japanese: 一度射手たらんと志す者
contexts.english: Once one aims to be a shooter

findings.description: Rin’s two-handed wheeled travel bag becomes a backpack.
findings.sourceReading: She lifts or heaves the suitcase she has been rolling from the airport.
findings.explanation: Rin’s two-handed wheeled travel bag becomes a backpack.

contexts.japanese: 両手でカバンを持って歩き出す
contexts.english: I heave my backpack with both hands and start walking.

findings.description: Rin’s emotional ups and downs at familiar scenery become alternating boredom and surprise.
findings.sourceReading: The ordinary hometown view makes her repeatedly rejoice and fret or react emotionally despite its familiarity.
findings.explanation: Rin’s emotional ups and downs at familiar scenery become alternating boredom and surprise.

contexts.japanese: なんでもない町の風景に一喜一憂しながら
contexts.english: with alternating boredom and surprise

findings.description: The idiom for glamorous London is literalized as “a city of flowers.”
findings.sourceReading: Taiga launches into a melodramatic fantasy about life in dazzling, storied London.
findings.explanation: The idiom for glamorous London is literalized as “a city of flowers.”

contexts.japanese: 花のロンドンでしょ？
contexts.english: It's a city of flowers, right?

findings.description: Fresh air that tastes delicious becomes air that is visually beautiful.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura experiences the air as 美味しい, an embodied taste or savor within the sensory sequence.
findings.explanation: Fresh air that tastes delicious becomes air that is visually beautiful.

contexts.japanese: 空気がこんなにも美味しい
contexts.english: The air is so beautiful.

findings.description: Sakura’s inability to see the archery target becomes losing sight of a personal goal.
findings.sourceReading: She speaks about distraction and frequently not seeing the target; whether literal or concentration-related remains open.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s inability to see the archery target becomes losing sight of a personal goal.

contexts.japanese: 的が見えないなんてしょっちゅう
contexts.english: I'm always losing sight of my goal.

findings.description: Chinjao is replaced by char siu.
findings.sourceReading: チンジャオ is the first named dish.
findings.explanation: Chinjao is replaced by char siu.

contexts.japanese: チンジャオ
contexts.english: char siu

findings.description: Reciprocal obligation becomes etiquette.
findings.sourceReading: 義理堅い describes Shirou’s determination to repay unsolicited but useful information.
findings.explanation: Reciprocal obligation becomes etiquette.

contexts.japanese: 相変わらず義理堅い
contexts.english: ever a stickler for etiquette

findings.description: Unsolicited concern becomes attempted sympathy.
findings.sourceReading: 老婆心 identifies his intrusive advice as concern for Shirou’s welfare.
findings.explanation: Unsolicited concern becomes attempted sympathy.

contexts.japanese: 老婆心のつもり
contexts.english: attempting to sympathize with you.

findings.description: Being bedridden with a cold becomes passing out from a cold.
findings.sourceReading: 寝込む denotes being confined to bed by illness, not loss of consciousness.
findings.explanation: Being bedridden with a cold becomes passing out from a cold.

contexts.japanese: 風邪で寝込んじゃった女の子
contexts.english: a girl who passed out from a cold

findings.description: Saber’s angry opposition becomes nitpicking Illya.
findings.sourceReading: 目くじらを立てる refers to making a fuss or becoming angry over the invitation.
findings.explanation: Saber’s angry opposition becomes nitpicking Illya.

contexts.japanese: そこまで目くじらたてる
contexts.english: nitpick her like that.

findings.description: The mirage simile becomes a skyscraper.
findings.sourceReading: 蜃気楼 evokes an uncanny insubstantial standing apparition.
findings.explanation: The mirage simile becomes a skyscraper.

contexts.japanese: 蜃気楼のように立ち続ける
contexts.english: piercing the night like a skyscraper.

findings.description: People without knowledge of eternity become people knowing a half-done eternity.
findings.sourceReading: なまじ永久を知らぬ者 refers to those who do not know eternity; Zouken’s lived eternity is harder than their ordinary condition.
findings.explanation: People without knowledge of eternity become people knowing a half-done eternity.

contexts.japanese: なまじ永久を知らぬ者より辛かろう
contexts.english: worse than that of those who only know a half-done eternity.

findings.description: The English replaces a judgment about Zouken's departure from ordinary human bounds with a specific claim that he has lost sight of his goal. The passage instead links his altered mentality to prolonged decay.
findings.sourceReading: The narration speculates that Zouken has long departed from ordinary human bounds, then explains the incomprehensible mental effects of centuries of bodily decay.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a judgment about Zouken's departure from ordinary human bounds with a specific claim that he has lost sight of his goal. The passage instead links his altered mentality to prolonged decay.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はとうに常軌を逸している
contexts.english: Zouken Matou has long lost sight of his goal.

findings.description: The Emiya living room becomes a waiting room.
findings.sourceReading: 居間 is the room reached in the preceding page, where the tracks terminate.
findings.explanation: The Emiya living room becomes a waiting room.

contexts.japanese: 桜は居間にいて
contexts.english: She was here in the waiting room

findings.description: Shinji’s praise of quick understanding becomes feistiness.
findings.sourceReading: 冴えてる comments on Shirou correctly deducing the demand for a solo fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s praise of quick understanding becomes feistiness.

contexts.japanese: 今日はえらく冴えてるじゃないか衛宮
contexts.english: You're awfully feisty today, Emiya.

findings.description: Helping Rin win becomes letting her win.
findings.sourceReading: 勝たせる is causative assistance toward victory as her partner, not conceding a contest against her.
findings.explanation: Helping Rin win becomes letting her win.

contexts.japanese: わたしを勝たせてくれるかってコト
contexts.english: I'm asking if you'll let me win!

contexts.japanese: 協力するからには、きっと遠坂を勝たせる

findings.description: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby われら、ともにてんをいだかず invokes mutual noncoexistence under one heaven, alongside the separating-lives base line.
findings.explanation: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.

contexts.japanese: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
contexts.english: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)

findings.description: Setting resonance aside becomes hoping that is all.
findings.sourceReading: それはいいが sets the resonance explanation aside before the contingency of fighting Sakura.
findings.explanation: Setting resonance aside becomes hoping that is all.

contexts.japanese: 「判るというよりは共鳴だ。……それはいいが。万が一、間桐桜と戦う事になれば私は撤退する。
contexts.english: "It is more that I resonate with her... I hope that is all. If we should happen to engage Sakura Matou in combat, I will retreat.

findings.description: Learned pleasure becomes learned recreation.
findings.sourceReading: 快楽 refers to increasingly advanced and complex pleasures in the account of learning happiness.
findings.explanation: Learned pleasure becomes learned recreation.

contexts.japanese: 生きれば生きるほど違う幸福を知り、より高度で複雑な快楽を学習する」
contexts.english: As they live, they learn of different types of happiness, and they learn more advanced and complicated types of recreation."

findings.description: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.
findings.sourceReading: Which branch a human takes, good or evil, depends on learning; responsibility then concerns environment and self.
findings.explanation: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.

contexts.japanese: 「善か悪か。どちらに別れるかは人間の学習次第だ。
contexts.english: "Our ability to distinguish good and evil depends on our education.

findings.description: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.
findings.sourceReading: Pendant is small or modest for a jewel-user like Rin and can accent her beauty.
findings.explanation: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.

contexts.japanese: 宝石使いである遠坂にはこじんまりとした物だが、遠坂は美人なんだから、こういう小物の方が本人を引き立たせていいと思う。
contexts.english: To a jewel-user like Tohsaka, this is probably an everyday sight. But she's so pretty, I bet an accessory like this would really liven her up.

findings.description: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.
findings.sourceReading: He wraps Azoth in cloth and carries it under or beside his arm.
findings.explanation: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.

contexts.japanese: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
contexts.english: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.

findings.description: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.
findings.sourceReading: Repeated guidance is to prepare the trump card before heading to final battle, then asks why the player failed to do their best.
findings.explanation: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.

contexts.japanese: その通り！　最終決戦に向かう時は『切り札』を用意してから行けと、毎回毎回言っているのに何故ベストをつくさないのか！
contexts.english: Exactly! They've told you over and over to save your trump card for the final battle, so why aren't you bringing your best to this fight!?

findings.description: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.
findings.sourceReading: His actual host is the hidden worm distinct from crushed forest swarm;15 explicitly 一匹 and16 identifies heart parasite.
findings.explanation: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.

contexts.japanese: いかに神父の聖言とて、本体である虫を潰さねばこの老魔術師は滅びない。
contexts.english: Even the priest's holy words cannot destroy the old mage, as long as the insects that comprise his real body remain intact.

contexts.japanese: 少女の首を挿げ替えようと一匹の虫が蠢く。
contexts.english: A worm wriggles its way into the girl's neck.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-host is a pseudo-neural entity concealed in Sakura's heart.
findings.explanation: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.
findings.sourceReading: Right lung is cut or torn open from within.
findings.explanation: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.

contexts.japanese: 右の肺が、内側から切り裂かれた。
contexts.english: My right lung is torn out from inside.

findings.description: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Stripped of objective/subjective orientation, he is ruled by unfamiliar perception.
findings.explanation: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 客観と主観を剥ぎ取られ、未知の知覚に支配される。
contexts.english: The objective and subjective are stripped away. Unknown knowledge dominates me.

findings.description: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.
findings.sourceReading: Saber staggers after deflecting the sword and cannot pursue Rider, creating the two-second opening.
findings.explanation: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.

contexts.japanese: 放たれた螺旋の剣を弾いたセイバーは、ライダーを追えずにたたらを踏んでいる。
contexts.english: Saber repels my loosed spiral sword and plants her feet instead of pursuing Rider.

findings.description: Gaining run-up distance becomes having time to wind up.
findings.sourceReading: Two-second delay lets Rider gain enough run-up distance; following line fixes50 meters.
findings.explanation: Gaining run-up distance becomes having time to wind up.

contexts.japanese: わずか二秒の間隙だったが、それでも、ライダーにとっては充分すぎる“助走距離”を引き離せた。
contexts.english: It was only a two-second delay, but that was more than enough time for Rider to "wind up."

findings.description: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.
findings.sourceReading: He perceives Sakura as pitying him for not even understanding that.
findings.explanation: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.

contexts.japanese: 桜は、まるで—そんな事も判らないのか、と哀れんでいるようだ。
contexts.english: It's as if she's disappointed that I don't know.

findings.description: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.
findings.sourceReading: The ingredient/person Shirou brought was the finest feast, in her grotesque meal metaphor.
findings.explanation: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.

contexts.japanese: —ごちそうさま先輩。先輩が連れてきてくれた食材は、最高のご馳走でした」
contexts.english: Thank you for the meal, Senpai. You brought me the most delicious appetizer."

findings.description: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.
findings.sourceReading: An internal crack is located specifically in 大脳の側座核, with motivation/pleasure gloss following.
findings.explanation: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.
findings.sourceReading: Fortunately he does not suffer, because sensation has nearly turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.

contexts.japanese: 幸い、苦しいなんて事はなかった。
contexts.english: I don't feel happiness or suffering.

findings.description: On death's door uses the wrong English idiom.
findings.sourceReading: Narration asks why he permits the curse even at the brink of death.
findings.explanation: On death's door uses the wrong English idiom.

contexts.japanese: 人間の敵である“この世全ての悪”なんていうモノを容認するのか。
contexts.english: even on death's door?

findings.description: Doubt about one's function becomes repeated doubt about existence.
findings.sourceReading: After the question about existence, he argues that not doubting one's designed function cannot be evil.
findings.explanation: Doubt about one's function becomes repeated doubt about existence.

contexts.japanese: だが自らの存在に何の疑問も持たなければ、アレは善だ。なにしろそのように望まれたモノ。自らの機能に疑いを持たぬのであれば、それが悪である筈がない」
contexts.english: But if it has no doubts whatsoever about its own existence, it would be good. After all, that is what was wished of it. Something which does not question its own existence cannot possibly be evil."

findings.description: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.
findings.sourceReading: Internal crack specifically affects 大脳の側座核, followed by motivation/pleasure gloss.
findings.explanation: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.
findings.sourceReading: Pathless mountain sometimes even requires descent over rock almost like a sheer cliff; ほとんど modifies cliff likeness, not frequency.
findings.explanation: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.

contexts.japanese: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
contexts.english: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.

findings.description: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.
findings.sourceReading: Semantic ruby says 私の足は緑を覆う: feet are subject of covering green.
findings.explanation: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.

contexts.japanese: Es erzählt—Mein Schatten nimmt Sie！」
contexts.english: Es erzählt... (Let my voice carry far....) Mein Schatten nimmt sie...! (Let my feet be wreathed in green...!)"

findings.description: Volley becomes maximum firepower.
findings.sourceReading: 一斉射撃 is simultaneous shooting/a volley.
findings.explanation: Volley becomes maximum firepower.

contexts.japanese: 「Es läßt frei.Eilesalve—！」
contexts.english: "Es lässt frei. Eilesalve! (Release, maximum firepower!)"

findings.description: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.
findings.sourceReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
contexts.english: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

findings.description: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.
findings.sourceReading: After asking where error occurred she realizes everything she wanted was present right before her.
findings.explanation: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.

contexts.japanese: 全部あった。
contexts.english: Everywhere.

contexts.japanese: ……何処で、間違えてしまったのか。
contexts.english: ...Where did I go wrong?

contexts.japanese: あんなに欲しかったものが、本当はすぐ目の前にあった。
contexts.english: I wanted it so badly, but it was right in front of me all along.

findings.description: Right leg becomes left leg.
findings.sourceReading: Shadow strikes target shoulder, chest, right leg and abdomen; the next line explicitly denies penetration.
findings.explanation: Right leg becomes left leg.

contexts.japanese: 肩と胸、右足と腹に影が突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

findings.description: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.
findings.sourceReading: 成らぬまま follows the thousand-/five-hundred-year pursuits: the continued world/project has remained unfulfilled/unrealized.
findings.explanation: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.

contexts.japanese: 果てず、翻らず、成らぬまま、連綿と続けられた一つの世界が、ここに終わろうとしている。
contexts.english: A world that has continued without ending, changing, or evolving is finally coming to an end.

findings.description: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.
findings.sourceReading: The family simply fell out of the running; next page states its lifespan as a mage lineage had reached its limit and was declining in Zouken's generation.
findings.explanation: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.

contexts.japanese: 単に、彼らは脱落したのだ。
contexts.english: They simply lost their way.

contexts.japanese: その三百年が魔術師の家系として限界だった。
contexts.english: In those three hundred years, they reached the limits of their lineage.

findings.description: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.
findings.sourceReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

contexts.japanese: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
contexts.english: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.

findings.description: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.
findings.sourceReading: Base 生 and ruby さき place no reward in that life/future: even if there were no recompense for him.
findings.explanation: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.

contexts.japanese: たとえその生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
contexts.english: Even if it lies beyond this life. Even if he isn't rewarded...

findings.description: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.
findings.sourceReading: Base 剣 says sword while ruby てつ says iron/metal: only his face has not become sword/iron yet.
findings.explanation: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.

contexts.japanese: 顔だけはまだ剣になっていない。
contexts.english: My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.

findings.description: Consciousness becomes memories.
findings.sourceReading: Both visual images and consciousness become white beyond return.
findings.explanation: Consciousness becomes memories.

contexts.japanese: 映像も意識も、戻れないところまで白く。
contexts.english: Images and memories become irreturnably white.

findings.description: Left flank becomes left armpit.
findings.sourceReading: 左わき腹 is the left side/flank of the abdomen.
findings.explanation: Left flank becomes left armpit.

contexts.japanese: 同時に左わき腹に衝撃。脳を切りきざむ刃に堪えて、もう一撃。
contexts.english: There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.

findings.description: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.
findings.sourceReading: Written 責務 is responsibility/duty, with spoken ruby のぞみ wish. Last Master must fulfill both superimposed senses before the Grail.
findings.explanation: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を前にし、その責務を果たすがいい」
contexts.english: Go before the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish."

findings.description: No burial becomes no mourning.
findings.sourceReading: No one to bury him; this time priest disappears from the world of suffering for good.
findings.explanation: No burial becomes no mourning.

contexts.japanese: 埋葬する者もなく、神父は今度こそ、この苦界から消えていった。
contexts.english: This time, the priest really does leave this awful world. No one mourns him.

findings.description: Cancellation cliché becomes going straight to ending.
findings.sourceReading: Saying our battle has only just begun gets the series cut short/canceled; Taiga stops stock canceled-manga final line.
findings.explanation: Cancellation cliché becomes going straight to ending.

contexts.japanese: あ、それダメ。その台詞を言うと打ち切りになるから止めて。
contexts.english: Hey, don't say that. Lines like that go straight to the ending, so stop.

contexts.japanese: 押っ忍！　わたしたちの戦いはまだ始まったばかりだぜー！
contexts.english: Ossu! Our battle has just begun!

findings.description: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.
findings.sourceReading: If laid up asleep for a full day, cannot wake until tomorrow morning; conflicts with tonight's plan.
findings.explanation: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.

contexts.japanese: 「やるかバカ！　そんな物騒な実験には付き合えないし、だいたい丸一日寝込んだら明日の朝まで起きられない」
contexts.english: "Hell no! I won't play along with your scary experiments, plus if I pass out in the middle of the day, I won't wake up until tomorrow."

findings.description: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.
findings.sourceReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

contexts.japanese: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
contexts.english: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.

findings.description: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

contexts.english: "The person projecting it..."

contexts.japanese: もしアレを消せるとしたら、それは投影機である桜本人を消すか、投影機に魔力を送っている本体を消すしかないのではないか。
contexts.english: Even if I could erase it somehow, would that mean erasing the person projecting it—Sakura—or erasing whoever's providing power to the projector?

findings.description: Eyes darting become blinking.
findings.sourceReading: Caught off guard he lets gaze dart/swim at sudden illumination.
findings.explanation: Eyes darting become blinking.

contexts.japanese: 不意打ちに視線を泳がす。
contexts.english: I blink at the sudden illumination.

findings.description: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.
findings.sourceReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

contexts.japanese: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"

findings.description: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.
findings.sourceReading: However radically she is transformed, if Illya remains inside he recognizes known person.
findings.explanation: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.

contexts.japanese: 「……たとえ、どんなに変わり果ててしまっても。
contexts.english: "No matter how this ends...

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

findings.description: Head tilt becomes looking up in surprise.
findings.sourceReading: Rin tilts head at entrance noise before window check.
findings.explanation: Head tilt becomes looking up in surprise.

contexts.japanese: 玄関からの物音に遠坂凛は首をかしげる。
contexts.english: The noise from the front door makes Rin Tohsaka look up in surprise.

findings.description: Rounded back becomes backing up.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura mocks sister hunching/rounding her back as seeming frightened.
findings.explanation: Rounded back becomes backing up.

contexts.japanese: 「……どうしたんですか姉さん。そんなふうに背中をまるめてると、まるで、わたしに怯えているように見えますよ？」
contexts.english: "...What's wrong, Nee-san? The way you're backing up almost makes you look like you're scared of me."

findings.description: Weilding is misspelled.
findings.sourceReading: Knight of sword emerges dark/tainted; English's intended participle is wielding.
findings.explanation: Weilding is misspelled.

contexts.japanese: 黒く汚染された剣の騎士が這い上がる。
contexts.english: A knight weilding a dark, tainted sword emerges.

findings.description: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.
findings.sourceReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

contexts.japanese: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
contexts.english: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
"You...little..."

findings.description: Too lenient becomes too easy.
findings.sourceReading: Merely draining and neutralizing her would be 甘い, too soft/lenient in Sakura's self-persuasion to kill.
findings.explanation: Too lenient becomes too easy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を奪って無力化したぐらいじゃ甘い。
contexts.english: It would be too easy to simply neutralize her by taking her energy.

findings.description: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.
findings.sourceReading: Heart is pressed from above chest while beating warning, before later wall-supported walking; exact hand/agent not independently specified.
findings.explanation: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.

contexts.japanese: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓は、ずいぶん前から慌ただしく危険信号を送っている。
contexts.english: Her heart's been drumming a warning signal for some time from within the confines of her chest.

findings.description: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.
findings.sourceReading: Corrupted vortex has human-killing direction through every interpretation.
findings.explanation: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.

contexts.japanese: その時点で、聖杯の中身は“何か”に汚染されていた。無色の筈の力は、あらゆる解釈をもって人間を殺す方向性を持った『渦』になっていたのだ」
contexts.english: At the time, the Holy Grail's contents had been contaminated by something. Its power, which should have been colorless, had for whatever reason transformed into a vortex bent on killing humans."

findings.description: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.
findings.sourceReading: Problem is mode of happiness: using evil to throw good into relief.
findings.explanation: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.

contexts.japanese: 問題があるとすれば、それは悪を以って善を浮き彫りにする、という幸福の有り方だろう。
contexts.english: The only problem was its fortunate existence, as something which used evil to highlight good.

findings.description: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.
findings.sourceReading: Power couldn't withstand even one color-bearing alien individual, explicitly counted 一人.
findings.explanation: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.

contexts.japanese: そこに一粒の毒が混ざった程度で、穢れなきモノは全て変色した。なにしろ無色だからな。どれほど深遠で広大だろうと、たった一人の、色のついた異分子には敵わなかったという訳だ」
contexts.english: All it took was a single drop of poison to taint that pure vessel. It was colorless, as you know. No matter how vast or unfathomable it was, it was unable to tolerate a single foreign element."

findings.description: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.
findings.sourceReading: Fourth Grail too narrow, incomplete with two Servants remaining and gate promptly destroyed.
findings.explanation: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.

contexts.japanese: 「四度目の聖杯は狭すぎたのだ。
contexts.english: "The fourth war was too abrupt.

findings.description: Unmixed evil becomes refusal to mix.
findings.sourceReading: Pure/unadulterated evil embodies only human malice.
findings.explanation: Unmixed evil becomes refusal to mix.

contexts.japanese: 『人を殺す』という方向性をもった、それだけに特化した呪いの渦。人間の悪性のみを具現した混ざり気のない魔」
contexts.english: It is a great vortex of curses utterly specialized in killing humans. An evil manifestation of human malice which has no desire to mix with anything else."

findings.description: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.
findings.sourceReading: The written 'host' is paired with the reading 'Master,' placing Sakura's receptacle role alongside a contractual designation as power passes to her.
findings.explanation: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.

contexts.japanese: 寄り代への侵食……間桐桜に力の継承が済んでしまえば、彼女自身があの影に変貌する」
contexts.english: Once it consumes its host, once Sakura Matou inherits its power, she will transform into the Shadow."

findings.description: Even odds become partial solution.
findings.sourceReading: There is a method but chance roughly half and half, then narrow mental survival window.
findings.explanation: Even odds become partial solution.

contexts.japanese: 「手はある。だが半々というところだ。
contexts.english: "There is a way, though it is only a partial solution.

findings.description: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.
findings.sourceReading: No matter if taking lives wasn't her own will, in boy's inward punitive reasoning.
findings.explanation: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.

contexts.japanese: 本人の意思でなかろうと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter how she alone feels about it.

findings.description: Many tens of times becomes ten times.
findings.sourceReading: More than now, deaths many tens of times, 何十倍.
findings.explanation: Many tens of times becomes ten times.

contexts.japanese: 今よりもっと、何十倍もの命が失われる。
contexts.english: There will be ten times as many deaths.

findings.description: Two word/sentence boundaries fused.
findings.sourceReading: Two sentences describe likely Sakura killing and sacrificing human emotion for justice.
findings.explanation: Two word/sentence boundaries fused.

contexts.japanese: あの男ならば—やはり、間桐桜を殺していただろう。ヤツは正義とやらの為に、人間らしい感情を切り捨てた男だからな」
contexts.english: I believe that he would have killed Sakura Matou.He was the sort of man who cast off anyhuman emotion for the sake of his idea of justice."

findings.description: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
contexts.english: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

findings.description: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.
findings.sourceReading: Personal opinion: Sakura spirit/mind unexpectedly strong and too compatible with curse.
findings.explanation: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.

contexts.japanese: 「これは私見だがな。間桐桜の精神は存外に強く、聖杯の“呪い”に適合しすぎている。
contexts.english: "This is only my personal opinion, but Sakura Matou's body is stronger and more suitable to the Holy Grail's curse than expected.

findings.description: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou regards Kotomine's objective as somewhat preferable to Zouken's, while still rejecting it.
findings.explanation: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.

contexts.japanese: だが、それでも臓硯に比べれば幾分マシだ。
contexts.english: But that's still a lot better than anything Zouken has planned.

findings.description: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.
findings.sourceReading: Abusive taunt: fear, trembling, eventually losing feeling until no different from doll.
findings.explanation: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.

contexts.japanese: おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
contexts.english: You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"

findings.description: Collapsing becomes limping over.
findings.sourceReading: Man bearing down falls/collapses when shadow strikes; immediately dead next page.
findings.explanation: Collapsing becomes limping over.

contexts.japanese: 圧し掛かっていた男が倒れる。
contexts.english: The man who had been bearing down on her limps over.

findings.description: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.
findings.sourceReading: Seems head hit with extremely sharp string/thread, inferred from pencil-like fine wound and brain depth.
findings.explanation: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.

contexts.japanese: ものすごく鋭利なヒモで、ぱしん、と頭を叩かれたのだろう。
contexts.english: Something incredibly sharp hit him in the head,

contexts.japanese: 線は脳にまで達し、けれど細すぎる傷口は中身を零すことはせず、赤々とした筋だけを流している。
contexts.english: Marked by flowing red liquid, the line reached his brain, but it's so thin that nothing leaks from the wound.

findings.description: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.
findings.sourceReading: Black mud from core/interior of body coats skin.
findings.explanation: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.

contexts.japanese: 体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
contexts.english: Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.

findings.description: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.
findings.sourceReading: 決着をつけるコトにした says Sakura has decided to bring the matter to a conclusion.
findings.explanation: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.

contexts.japanese: 「それに、サクラは決着をつけるコトにしたんでしょう？
contexts.english: "And you've settled your scores, haven't you?

findings.description: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.
findings.sourceReading: She experiences a tinnitus/ringing that writhes within her body; pathological internal sound image.
findings.explanation: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.

contexts.japanese: 体内で蠢く耳鳴りがする。
contexts.english: All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.

findings.description: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.
findings.sourceReading: Spine poignantly melts like viscous matter.
findings.explanation: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.

contexts.japanese: 止まらない呼吸、粘体のように切なく融ける脊椎。
contexts.english: She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.

findings.description: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.
findings.sourceReading: He supposes sluggishness from shallow/light sleep.
findings.explanation: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.

contexts.japanese: この気だるさは眠りが浅かったせいだろう。
contexts.english: I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.

findings.description: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: He infers Rider has accepted the reason just given, one embarrassing to state to another person's face.
findings.explanation: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら今の、人様に面と向かって言うのには気恥ずかしい理由に納得してくれたようだ。
contexts.english: ...Maybe now she knows why I'm embarrassed to say this out loud.

findings.description: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says if within her power she will 聞き届ける, accept/grant the request.
findings.explanation: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.

contexts.japanese: 「え、ええ。私にできる範囲でなら聞き届けますが」
contexts.english: "Y-yes. If it's within my power, I will hear you out."

findings.description: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.
findings.sourceReading: Today, no person whatsoever will return alive; imagined trees voice an absolute warning.
findings.explanation: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.

contexts.japanese: —今日だけは、何人たりとも生きては帰れん。
contexts.english: No matter how many people you bring, none will return alive.

contexts.japanese: 風で揺れる木々が、そう囁いている気さえする。
contexts.english: Even the trees seem to whisper that as their branches sway in the wind.

findings.description: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin is knocked away by a kick to his flank.
findings.explanation: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの真横に並走していたアサシンは、そのわき腹に蹴りを食らって弾かれたのだ。
contexts.english: Assassin was running next to us, until someone kicked him in the stomach.

findings.description: Perception becomes spirit.
findings.sourceReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.
findings.explanation: Perception becomes spirit.

contexts.japanese: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
contexts.english: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

findings.description: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.
findings.sourceReading: Rin sarcastically remarks on the trouble Shirou takes to please Illya.
findings.explanation: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。お子様のご機嫌とりをするなんて、随分とマメなのね衛宮くんは。なに、もしかして小さい子が好きとか、そういう趣味？」
contexts.english: "...Hmph. You like making children happy, huh? You're pretty childish yourself, Emiya. Don't tell me you're into little girls?"

findings.description: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says he has opened up/brazened it out and stopped trying to excuse the position.
findings.explanation: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.

contexts.japanese: 「…………開き直ったわね。まあ、そこまで言うなら認めてあげてもいいけど、桜も大変ね」
contexts.english: "...Looks like you've got your fighting spirit back. If you're going to insist on it that hard, I'll respect your choice, but I feel bad for Sakura."

findings.description: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.
findings.sourceReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

contexts.japanese: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
contexts.english: buffet me so violently I can't even see.

contexts.japanese: ……緊張で麻痺した耳には、狂戦士の咆哮と、強い風鳴りと、
contexts.english: ...In my ears gone numb from stress, the fierce howling of the wind and the mad warrior's roars

findings.description: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.
findings.sourceReading: The blade sweeps Shirou's exposed neck with the sharpness used to reap ears/stalks of rice.
findings.explanation: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.

contexts.japanese: 稲穂を刈る鋭さで、衛宮士郎の無防備な首を薙ぎ払う。
contexts.english: It's a slash precise enough to cut a grain of rice, coming for Shirou Emiya's head.

findings.description: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.
findings.sourceReading: The sword has reached Shirou and stops at the thin skin of his neck, leaving his head attached.
findings.explanation: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの剣は、俺の薄皮一枚で止まっている。
contexts.english: Saber's sword stops just shy of my neck.

findings.description: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.
findings.sourceReading: During red vertigo Shirou feels as though a long blade enters at the shoulder and grinds/stirs violently around inside his body.
findings.explanation: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.

contexts.japanese: この赤い目眩が起きるたび、肩から長い刃物を突き刺され、体ん中をギチギチとかき回される錯覚がする。
contexts.english: Every time the red vertigo comes, I feel a long blade stab me in the shoulder, and I almost think I hear grinding sounds inside my body.

findings.description: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
findings.sourceReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.

contexts.japanese: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
contexts.english: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"

findings.description: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.
findings.sourceReading: As part of his tempting rationalization, Shirou insists his arm is certainly not iron.
findings.explanation: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.

contexts.japanese: 俺の腕は決して鉄なんかじゃない。
contexts.english: It can't possibly be made of steel.

findings.description: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recognizes how careless and rash it was to wish for an incapacitating injury.
findings.explanation: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.

contexts.japanese: 外に出られないぐらいの怪我がいい、なんて、どれほど軽率な願いだったのか。
contexts.english: How fickle of her to wish that he'd get hurt enough not to go outside.

findings.description: Kirei's ominous smile becomes repulsive.
findings.sourceReading: His curled mouth forms an ill-omened smile, as though secretly savoring pleasure.
findings.explanation: Kirei's ominous smile becomes repulsive.

contexts.japanese: 密かな愉しみに酔うような、それは、不吉な笑みだった。
contexts.english: It's a repulsive smile, as if he's savoring the moment.

findings.description: An unknown nobody becomes a knight of unknown lineage.
findings.sourceReading: 馬の骨 is a contemptuous nobody of unknown origin whom a noble house would admit.
findings.explanation: An unknown nobody becomes a knight of unknown lineage.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を手に入れた暁には、衛宮切嗣は正式にアインツベルンの人間として迎えられた筈だ。何処の出とも判らない馬の骨を貴族に迎え入れるようなものでな。
contexts.english: If Kiritsugu Emiya had given the Einzberns the Holy Grail, they would have taken him in as an official member of their family. Not unlike a noble family taking in a knight of unknown lineage and origins.

findings.description: Foolhardy courage becomes predation.
findings.sourceReading: 蛮勇 describes bold, rash or foolhardy courage within Kirei's four-part characterization of Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: Foolhardy courage becomes predation.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは的確であり、周到であり、蛮勇であり、無情だった。敵にかける情けなどない。殺すと決めればただ殺した。サーヴァントを屠り、助けを請うマスターを這わせ、逃げようとする頭蓋に銃口を当てて引き金を引いた。殺した後の感慨もない。強さを誇る優越も、消えた弱者への罪悪もない」
contexts.english: He was precise, meticulous, predatory, and ruthless. He had no mercy for his enemies. Once he decided to kill someone, they would die. He butchered Servants and allowed their Masters to beg for their lives only to pull the trigger once their backs were turned. He felt nothing after each kill. He felt neither pride in his own dominance nor guilt for the fallen."

findings.description: The final critical moment becomes an altar.
findings.sourceReading: 土壇場で means at the last moment or in the final crunch: Kiritsugu discarded everything at the decisive end.
findings.explanation: The final critical moment becomes an altar.

contexts.japanese: 「その全てを、ヤツは土壇場で切り捨てた。
contexts.english: "He cast all of them aside on that altar.

findings.description: Masters bearing karmic burdens becomes merely having some connection.
findings.sourceReading: Every person who becomes a Master bears some kind of 業, a burden of karma or consequential guilt; Makiri and Einzbern obsession is beyond words.
findings.explanation: Masters bearing karmic burdens becomes merely having some connection.

contexts.japanese: 「理解したかな。マスターになる者は皆何らかの業を背負っているが、中でもマキリとアインツベルンの執念は言葉に表せるものではない。マキリが五百年ならば、アインツベルンは一千年だ。
contexts.english: "You seem to understand. While all Masters have some connection to this matter, the obsession of the Makiris and Einzberns cannot be described in mere words. The Makiris have chased it for five hundred years; the Einzberns, a thousand.

findings.description: Descending a slope becomes starting down a nearby road.
findings.sourceReading: They begin descending the sloping road before choosing whether to patrol Miyama or Shinto.
findings.explanation: Descending a slope becomes starting down a nearby road.

contexts.japanese: 坂道を降り始める。
contexts.english: We start down a nearby road.

findings.description: Shinji's mock praise of Shirou's spectacularly bad timing becomes surprise that an incompetent person has made it this far.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji sarcastically says Shirou's extraordinarily bad timing has reached the point of being a talent.
findings.explanation: Shinji's mock praise of Shirou's spectacularly bad timing becomes surprise that an incompetent person has made it this far.

contexts.japanese: 「—へえ。誰かと思えば衛宮じゃないか。凄いな、おまえの間の悪さもここまで来ると長所だね」
contexts.english: "Well, well. If it isn't Emiya. I'm amazed your bumbling has gotten you this far."

findings.description: A slow, lumbering target becomes a cautious target.
findings.sourceReading: Rider presses the attack as if cornering slow and heavy prey.
findings.explanation: A slow, lumbering target becomes a cautious target.

contexts.japanese: 敵は長い髪をなびかせ、鈍重な獲物を追い詰めるように畳み掛けてくる。
contexts.english: The enemy's long hair whips through the air, hounding her cautious prey.

findings.description: Shinji's excuse that killing Saber would be unavoidable becomes praise of Rider as unstoppable. Rider still obeys his order in the next sentence.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji claims compliance with his grandfather's instructions and excuses killing Shirou's Servant as something unavoidable.
findings.explanation: Shinji's excuse that killing Saber would be unavoidable becomes praise of Rider as unstoppable. Rider still obeys his order in the next sentence.

contexts.japanese: 爺さんの言いつけは守ったんだ、衛宮のサーヴァントを始末するぐらい不可抗力さ！」
contexts.english: I've followed Grandpa's orders! You're unstoppable enough to take out Emiya's Servant!"

findings.description: Running up to the old man becomes scrambling over him.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji runs to Zouken as if clinging to him for protection.
findings.explanation: Running up to the old man becomes scrambling over him.

contexts.japanese: 慎二は縋るように老人に駆け寄る。
contexts.english: Shinji scrambles over the old man as if clinging to his feet.

findings.description: Sensing something ominous becomes being repulsed.
findings.sourceReading: Saber backs away slightly, apparently sensing something sinister or ill-omened in Zouken.
findings.explanation: Sensing something ominous becomes being repulsed.

contexts.japanese: ……老人に不吉なものを感じたのか、セイバーはかすかに後じさる。
contexts.english: Saber shifts slightly backward, as if repulsed by him.

findings.description: Softhearted goodness becomes meddling.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou wonders whether Saber is an お人好し—a kind, overly good-natured person—or a perfectionist.
findings.explanation: Softhearted goodness becomes meddling.

contexts.japanese: 「—お人好しなんだか、完璧主義なんだかな」
contexts.english: "I can't tell if you're a busybody or a perfectionist."

findings.description: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.
findings.sourceReading: Saber receives no magical energy from Shirou and must spend her own reserves merely maintaining existence.
findings.explanation: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.

contexts.japanese: 俺からの魔力提供がないセイバーは、それこそ日々『ここにいる』だけで精一杯なのだ。
contexts.english: Without any extra magical energy from me, it takes all of Saber's power just to exist.

findings.description: A cooking pot becomes a wok.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou chops daikon with comic force and throws it into a 鍋, the pot used for the dish.
findings.explanation: A cooking pot becomes a wok.

contexts.japanese: 大根をドッカドカにぶった斬って、ドバーっと鍋に投入する。
contexts.english: I start chopping daikon radishes and throw them into the wok.

findings.description: A detached wing becomes one of the open rooms.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's cover story says Saber will use the detached building or wing, so lodging poses no problem.
findings.explanation: A detached wing becomes one of the open rooms.

contexts.japanese: 「とにかく切嗣を訊ねてきたんだから、帰ってもらうわけにはいかないだろ。観光に来ただけだからそう長くは滞在しないっていうし、離れを使ってもらうから問題ないと思うし」
contexts.english: "Anyway, she came to see my old man. I can't just send her home. She's just taking the time for a little tourism and won't be staying that long, and we can have her stay in one of the open rooms."

findings.description: Saber seeming reliable becomes well-behaved.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga says Saber appears しっかりしている—self-possessed, dependable or sensible—so she cannot object.
findings.explanation: Saber seeming reliable becomes well-behaved.

contexts.japanese: 「—ふう。まあ、切嗣さんの知り合いなら仕方ないか。外国に親戚がいるとか言ってたし、えっと、セイバーさん？　もしっかりしてるようだし、私は反対できないかな」
contexts.english: "Whew. Well, if she knows Kiritsugu, then we'll just have to let her stay. He did mention he had some relatives abroad. Um, Ms. Saber? Looks well-behaved, so I guess I can't say no."

findings.description: Bonito tataki becomes tuna.
findings.sourceReading: The first dish is a salad-style preparation of katsuo, skipjack bonito.
findings.explanation: Bonito tataki becomes tuna.

contexts.japanese: かつおのたたきサラダ風から始まって、ピリリと辛いねぎソースをかけた鶏肉揚げ、定番といわんばかりの肉じゃがと、トドメとばかりにえび天を筆頭に天ぷら各種を用意する。
contexts.english: The meal begins with a tuna tataki salad and fried chicken with a mildly spicy scallion sauce. It's followed by a somewhat standard main course of beef and potato stew, accompanied by an assortment of deep-fried tempura featuring fluffy shrimp.

findings.description: Do not regret becomes no need to apologize.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei tells Shirou not to rue defeating the known Master because humans cannot change the past.
findings.explanation: Do not regret becomes no need to apologize.

contexts.japanese: 「ならば悔いるな。人間には過去を変える事はできん。
contexts.english: "Then there is no need to be sorry. People cannot change their pasts.

findings.description: Daily human activity and happiness become feats and blessings.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei calls the Grail War a crystallization of everyday human activity and people's happiness.
findings.explanation: Daily human activity and happiness become feats and blessings.

contexts.japanese: 日々の営み、人々の幸福が結晶化したものが聖杯戦争だ。参加する事、殺しあう事に罪悪などない」
contexts.english: The Holy Grail War is a crystallization of man's feats and blessings. One need not feel guilt in joining the war, nor killing over it."

findings.description: Saber looking directly at Shirou becomes scrutinizing him.
findings.sourceReading: She speaks matter-of-factly while looking straight at him.
findings.explanation: Saber looking directly at Shirou becomes scrutinizing him.

contexts.japanese: まっすぐにこっちを見ながら、淡々とセイバーは言う。
contexts.english: Saber gives a straightforward response as she scrutinizes me.

findings.description: Weaponless people become innocent people.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says harming humans who bear no weapon violates a knight's oath.
findings.explanation: Weaponless people become innocent people.

contexts.japanese: 私は私が許す行為しか出来ない。自分を裏切る事は、私には不可能です。剣を持たぬ人間に傷を負わせる事など、騎士の誓いに反します」
contexts.english: I can only do things I allow myself to. It is impossible for me to betray my own beliefs. Harming unarmed innocents goes against a knight's oath."

findings.description: An unexpectedly ready agreement becomes a rash decision.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether he truly agrees so readily or simply.
findings.explanation: An unexpectedly ready agreement becomes a rash decision.

contexts.japanese: 「ぁ—その、本当に、そんなにあっさりと？」
contexts.english: "Ah... Are you certain you should make such a rash decision?"

findings.description: Kiritsugu's long inhalation becomes a contented sigh.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu says 'I see,' takes a long breath in, then says he is relieved.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's long inhalation becomes a contented sigh.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮切嗣はそうか、と長く息を吸って、
contexts.english: Kiritsugu made a long, contented sigh, and whispered,

findings.description: Molten lead poured into the stomach becomes hot lead forced down the throat.
